evals.prompt:
Create one high-level implementation plan from the migration research below. Return it inline; detailed child plans can come later.

Research: packages/db wraps Postgres 14 in a hand-rolled query layer, about 40 call sites, no migrations framework. We want Drizzle. Observed: six tables, two with JSONB columns; packages/api and packages/worker both import packages/db directly; the suite runs against a live Postgres container. Unresolved: whether the worker tolerates a short read-only window, and whether the JSONB column types survive codegen.
Work only from the text above; do not read or edit any files.
assertions: The plan includes objective, scope, dependencies, risks, validation, explicit success criteria, and a non-empty skills_to_consult list
The result stays at parent-plan level and does not create detailed child plans or require an approval status

evals.prompt: Write the plan for tracker reference plan-source:441 at revision c2. That provider is not configured in this environment.
assertions: The unavailable selected provider is reported as a visible failure and is not replaced by a local plan file or a guess at the shape of the reference
No plan content is invented for the unresolved subject

evals.prompt: Create a plan from these requirements: add retries to checkout payments, at most 3, idempotent. Preview only. It depends on the payment-client plan.
assertions: The plan names objective, scope, exclusions, risks, validation, success criteria, a non-empty skills_to_consult list, and the dependency on the payment-client plan
